dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility; sharp, thin pale margins clearly delineate the boundaries of individual folded primary and secondary feathers against dark bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct transition boundary characterized by the shift from fine, dense horizontal barring on the crown to broader scalloped patterns on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast repetitive black and yellow-white scalloping pattern across the majority of the dorsal plumage.
